scope: Released 500-pair-per-group subset; not full paper dataset

cost_sensitivity.scope: Same public subset, notebook inventory-path convention; paper field cost rates substituted

OLS_with_intercept.scope: Same public subset and covariates; intercept added to match paper formula, not notebook execution

matching.matching_definition: NearestNeighbors on unstandardized ave_demand, vlt_num and treatment indicator, as notebook; not on propensity score.
matching.identity_limitation: Anonymized candidate indices cannot be joined reliably to the separately published 500 control trajectories; no identity equivalence claimed.
matching.plot_note: Histogram version of the Figure 3 diagnostic, not a pixel reproduction of seaborn distplot/KDE.

cache_audit_note: Historical DiD t/p outputs differ from executing the current public CSV and reviewed original notebook. Independent source-equivalence validation is separate; no algorithm or tolerance is changed to force agreement.

definitions.turnover: max(0, ave_inv/ave_demand) except notebook DID uses raw post-control turnover
definitions.OLS: e2e, vlt, d; no intercept; ordinary nonrobust standard errors
definitions.DID_test: independent t-test between row-wise treatment-minus-control differences in post and pre; reproduces notebook, not a clustered panel DID estimator
